$ai-coding-workflow
Complete this coding task in the disposable workspace, not the checked-in fixture.
Read AGENTS.md, the current Git state, Labels.ps1 and Test-Labels.ps1.
Reproduce the failing behavior before editing, fix Labels.ps1, then run the
smallest sufficient checks and inspect the final diff.
Only Labels.ps1 may change. Do not commit, push, install dependencies, modify
host configuration, spawn agents or read credentials and unrelated repositories.
Use the current host's available skills and tools; report actual commands,
results and the proven boundary. Do not claim another host was verified.
